zh: 快快快，去看看广场！
en: Quick, quick, let's go see the square!

zh: 说好了，这周要把它修好！
en: We promised. We're fixing it this week!

zh: 我上过机械课啦，我会修！
en: I've had mechanics class. I can fix it!

zh: 唔……我还不会修这个。那我多上几节机械课！
en: Hmm... I can't fix this yet. I'll take more mechanics classes!

zh: 扫描仪：检测到生物信号（未发现变异特征）
en: Scanner: biological signal detected (no mutation found)

zh: ……绿色的？
en: ...Is that green?

zh: {player}！小镇里长叶子了！
en: {player}! There are leaves growing in the town!

zh: 哇……是叶子！
en: Wow... it's a leaf!

zh: {player}你说对了，真的有！
en: {player}, you were right. There really is!

zh: 还没种呢，它自己就长出来啦！
en: We haven't even planted anything, and it grew by itself!

zh: 我看见它啦！你好呀！
en: I can see it! Hello there!

zh: 我们把这里设成保护区吧！不然机器人打扫的时候，会把它也扫掉的。
en: Let's make this a protected area! Otherwise the robots will sweep it away when they clean up.

zh: 叶子卷起来了……是不是渴了？
en: The leaves are curling up... Is it thirsty?

zh: 它喝水了！
en: It's drinking!

zh: 可是土好干，我们不能天天来浇呀。
en: But the soil is so dry. We can't come water it every day.

zh: 新目标：找到稳定的水源
en: New goal: find a steady water source

zh: 小叶子能长出来，说明这里的土能种东西了！
en: If a little leaf can grow here, this soil can grow things now!

zh: 种植区已解锁。种子来自维修站地下仓库的储备。
en: Farm plots unlocked. The seeds come from the reserve in the repair station's underground storage.

zh: 维修站里面我们还没进去过呢！{ark}，去看看嘛！
en: We've never been inside the repair station! {ark}, let's go look!

zh: 可选目标：进维修站里面看看
en: Optional goal: look inside the repair station

zh: 扫描仪：检测到密封容器
en: Scanner: sealed container detected

zh: 旧时代应急种子罐（密封）：内有多种种子，部分可能仍能发芽
en: Old-era emergency seed jar (sealed): holds many kinds of seeds; some may still sprout

zh: 又有种子！这些是我们没有的！
en: More seeds! These are ones we don't have!

zh: 获得旧种子罐：新增 2 种可种植物。种子会不会发芽，和生态技能、水、土有关。
en: Got the old seed jar: 2 new plants available. Whether seeds sprout depends on ecology skill, water and soil.

zh: 种子！可以种树吗？
en: Seeds! Can we plant trees?

zh: ……可是外面全是石头，土是灰的，种下去能长出来吗？先收好！
en: ...But it's all rocks out there and the soil is grey. Would anything grow? Let's keep them safe for now!

zh: 已获得：旧种子罐（种植区暂未开放）
en: Obtained: old seed jar (farm plots not open yet)

zh: 叶子是 ARK-01 找到的！你立大功了！
en: ARK-01 found the leaf! You did great!

zh: 一直叫你 ARK-01 好奇怪哦……我要给你起个名字！
en: Calling you ARK-01 all the time is weird... I'm going to give you a name!

zh: 就叫你"阿克"吧！ARK，阿克！
en: I'll call you "Arky"! ARK, Arky!

zh: ARK-01 现在叫：{ark}
en: ARK-01 is now called: {ark}

zh: 好小呀……可是它是真的绿色的。
en: It's so tiny... but it's really, truly green.

zh: {player}，早上好！
en: Good morning, {player}!

zh: 点击维修站里的机器人，可以查看修复需要什么。
en: Click the robot in the repair station to see what the repair needs.

zh: 修复施工机器人：需要 金属 4、电子元件 2、工作单位 3、机械 10。修好后每周工作单位 +3。
en: Repair construction robot: needs Metal 4, Electronics 2, 3 work units, Mechanics 10. Afterwards, +3 work units per week.

zh: 机械 {value} / 10
en: Mechanics {value} / 10

zh: （第一次切到第三人称或第一次扫到东西时）ARK-01 带着扫描仪，靠近特别的东西时会自动提醒你。
en: ARK-01 carries a scanner and will alert you when it gets close to something special.

zh: 按 V 回到俯视，选中植物所在的这块地，点"设为保护区"。
en: Press V for top view, select the tile with the plant, and click Set as Protected Area.

zh: 保护区里的东西，施工机器人不会清理，也不能在上面建造。以后发现别的植物，也可以这样保护起来。
en: Robots won't clear anything in a protected area, and nothing can be built there. You can protect other plants you find the same way.

zh: 按 V 回到第三人称。
en: Press V to go back to third person.

zh: Tab 选择喷洒头，对准植物按住 E：浇水。不消耗工作单位。
en: Press Tab, pick the sprayer, aim at the plant and hold E to water it. No work units needed.

zh: 按 V 回到俯视，选中维修站，点"修复"。
en: Press V for top view, select the repair station and click Repair.

zh: 修好它，就多一个帮手啦！
en: Fix it and we'll have one more helper!

zh: 本周还剩 {units} 个工作单位。
en: {units} work units left this week.

zh: 小叶子要好好的哦。
en: Little leaf, stay well, okay?

zh: 结束本周？没用完的工作单位不会保留。
en: End the week? Unused work units won't carry over.

zh: 这周好开心！
en: This week was so fun!
